'''Gloomthorn Trail''' is a trail connecting the [[Tlati Rainforest]] and [[Nemus Retreat]]. The trail runs between a tributary of [[River Varla]] to the east and the sea surrounding [[Tempestus]] to the west. The landscape is mostly featureless except for a number of [[dead trees]] and an abandoned keep with a [[crate (Gloomthorn Trail)|crate]] that is used for a [[Clue scroll (medium) - Search the crate abandoned in the shadow of a mountain's grace|medium clue step]]. At the north end of the trail, [[Achilka]] has a ferry service that can take the player to [[Tal Teklan]] and [[Kastori]] free of charge.

==Transportation==
* Using the [[Quetzal Transport System]] (must be built before it can be used) to [[Kastori]] and then running east to use [[Achilka|Achilka's boat service]].
* [[Pendant of Ates]] teleport to Kastori and run south east to use Achilka's boat service.
* Pendant of Ates teleport to [[Nemus Retreat]] and run south
* If you don't have the Kastori Quetzal landing site or the Pendant of Ates: Use the [[Quetzal Transport System]] to [[Quetzacalli Gorge]], follow the [[mountain Guide (Auburn Valley)|mountain guide]] to [[Auburn Valley]], then run south.

==Inhabitants==
* [[Achilka]]
* [[Black unicorn]]
* [[Crow]]
* [[Giant bat]] (level 27)
* [[Grizzly bear]]
* [[Imp]] (level 2)
* [[Rat]]
* [[Squirrel]]
* [[Wolf]] (level 64)

==Treasure Trails==
[[Clue scroll (medium) - Search the crate abandoned in the shadow of a mountain's grace|Search the crate abandoned in the shadow of a mountain's grace]] - Search the [[Crate (Gloomthorn Trail)|crate]] inside the lone building
